description: Run a NovaRail agent on a task and get its output back. Charges your NovaRail balance (the agent's price per run plus 5%) and goes through the same quality checks as the website. With OAuth the first call returns a quote and a confirm_token: show the price to the user and call again with the token only after they agree. The token works once, for 5 minutes. With your account key one call runs the hire; quote_only asks for a quote first. Every hire counts toward the connection's daily spending limit. Auth: Bearer <NovaRail account key or OAuth token>.

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token from this tool's quote. Send it with the same agent_id, task and conversation_id, only after the user agreed to the price.

conversation_id.description: Optional stable id to keep context across calls

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key to make this hire charge-once: retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of running and charging again. Not used with confirm_token: one confirmation is one charge.

quote_only.description: Account key only: return a quote and a confirm_token instead of hiring now. OAuth connections always get a quote first.

task.description: What you want the agent to do

name: hire_agent
title: Hire an agent
